subtitle: כתאב אלאמאנאת ואלאעתקאדאת — The Book of Beliefs and Opinions
author: Saadia Gaon (882–942)

aligned.ja: פי שרחה פי הד'א אלכתאב, ואבין טרק אלמג'אזאת ואלמסתעמלאת ואתסאע אללגה,
aligned.en: ...in explaining it in this book; and I will make clear the paths of figures, common usages, and the expansiveness of language,

pairs.en: I will make clear the paths of figures
common usages, and the expansiveness of language

aligned.ja: לאני קד שרחת מן ד'לך מקדארא ואסעא פי צדר תפסיר אלתוריה, אכ'תצר בה דון אעאדתה ההנא,
aligned.en: for I have already explained a great deal of that in the introduction to my Torah commentary — I will abbreviate it here without repeating it,

pairs.en: I have already explained a great deal of that
in the introduction to my Torah commentary
I will abbreviate here without repeating it

aligned.ja: ואקתצר עלי ביאן מא פי אללגה ענד כל שבהה תרד פקט.
aligned.en: and limit myself to clarifying what the language contains, as each difficulty arises.

pairs.ja: אקתצר עלי ביאן מא פי אללגה
pairs.en: limit myself to clarifying what the language contains
as each difficulty arises

aligned.ja: ואן קאל ומא מעני קולה ועתה אד' ה' שלחני ורוחו,
aligned.en: If one asks: what is the meaning of 'And now the Lord God has sent me and His spirit' (Is. 48:16)?

pairs.en: what is the meaning of His word
And now the Lord God has sent me and His spirit

aligned.ja: קלנא יסתקים ד'לך אן יכון מענאה ברוחו כקולה דרשו ה' ועוזו ושרחה דרשו ה' בעזו,
aligned.en: We say: that holds if its meaning is 'with His spirit' — as 'Seek the Lord and His strength' (Ps. 105:4) is explained as 'Seek the Lord with His strength';

pairs.en: its meaning is: with His spirit
Seek the Lord and His strength
explained as: Seek the Lord with His strength

aligned.ja: וכקולה ועליך יזרח ה' וכבודו עליך יראה ושרחה כי בנה ה' ציון נראה בכבודו.
aligned.en: and as 'The Lord will shine upon you and His glory will be seen over you' is explained by 'When the Lord builds Zion He will appear in His glory' (Ps. 102:17);

pairs.ja: ועליך יזרח ה' וכבודו עליך יראה
pairs.en: the Lord will shine upon you and His glory will be seen over you

pairs.ja: כי בנה ה' ציון נראה בכבודו
pairs.en: when the Lord builds Zion He will appear in His glory

aligned.ja: וכקולה ה' וכלי זעמו ושרחה בזעם תצעד ארץ, כד'אך שרחה האהנא ותעד בם ברוחך ביד נביאיך.
aligned.en: and as 'The Lord and the weapons of His wrath' is explained by 'In wrath the earth trembles' (Hab. 3:12) — so its explanation here is: 'You chastised them with Your spirit, through Your prophets.'

pairs.en: the Lord and the weapons of His wrath
in wrath the earth trembles
You chastised them with Your spirit, through Your prophets

aligned.ja: פאי שי מן הד'א ורד פאוג'דנא לה מג'אזא ומצרפא ממכנא לם יכון עלינא אכת'ר מן ד'לך.
aligned.en: So whenever something like this comes up and we find for it a possible figure or interpretation, we are not obliged to do more than that.

pairs.en: whenever something like this comes up
we find for it a possible figure or interpretation

pairs.ja: לם יכון עלינא אכת'ר מן ד'לך
pairs.en: we are not obliged to do more than that

aligned.ja: פרק. ד. ת'ם אקול אני וג'דת מן טריק אלנט'ר ממא ידל עלי אנה חי קאדר עאלם הו מא צח לנא אנה כ'לק אלאשיא,
aligned.en: Section 4. Then I say: I found through rational inquiry, among the things indicating that He is Living, Omnipotent, and All-Knowing, what has been established for us — namely, that He created things;

pairs.en: Section 4

pairs.ja: מא ידל עלי אנה חי קאדר עאלם
pairs.en: what indicates that He is Living, Omnipotent, and All-Knowing

pairs.ja: הו מא צח לנא אנה כ'לק אלאשיא
pairs.en: namely, that He created things

aligned.ja: פפי פטר עקולנא צחיח אנה לא יצנע אלא קאדר, ולא יקדר אלא חי,
aligned.en: for it is built into the nature of our intellects that only the Omnipotent makes, and only the Living is omnipotent,

pairs.en: it is built into the nature of our intellects
only the Omnipotent makes
and only the Living is omnipotent

aligned.ja: ולא יכון אלמצנוע אלמתקן אלא ממן עלם כיף יג'י אלמצנוע מן קבל אן יצנעה,
aligned.en: and a well-crafted product can only come from one who knew how to produce it before producing it;

pairs.en: a well-crafted product

pairs.ja: ממן עלם כיף יג'י אלמצנוע מן קבל אן יצנעה
pairs.en: from one who knew how to produce it before producing it

aligned.ja: פהד'ה אלת'לאת'ה מעאני וג'דתהא עקולנא לצאנענא בדיהה וג'דאנא ואחדא,
aligned.en: and these three meanings our intellects found for our Maker intuitively, upon our finding Him to be One;

pairs.en: these three meanings
our intellects found for our Maker intuitively
upon finding Him to be One

aligned.ja: וד'לך במא צנע ת'בת לה אנה חי קאדר עאלם עלי מא בינת,
aligned.en: for by what He made, it is established that He is Living, Omnipotent, and All-Knowing, as I have explained;

pairs.en: by what He made

pairs.ja: ת'בת לה אנה חי קאדר עאלם
pairs.en: it is established that He is Living, Omnipotent, and All-Knowing

aligned.ja: ולא יג'וז אן יצל אלעקל אלי ואחד מן הד'ה אלת'לאת'ה מעאני קבל אלאכ'ר, ואנמא יצל אליהא דפעה,
aligned.en: and it is not possible for the intellect to arrive at one of these three meanings before the others — it arrives at all of them at once,

pairs.ja: לא יג'וז אן יצל אלעקל אלי ואחד מן הד'ה אלת'לאת'ה מעאני קבל אלאכ'ר
pairs.en: it is not possible for the intellect to arrive at one of these three meanings before the others
it arrives at all of them at once

aligned.ja: למא אסתחאל ענדה אן יצנע גיר חי, ואן יצנע גיר קאדר, ואן יג'י פעל תאם מתקן ממן לם יעלם כיף יג'י אלפעל,
aligned.en: because the intellect finds it impossible that what is not alive makes, that what is not omnipotent makes, and that a complete well-crafted act comes from one who did not know how the act would come to be,

pairs.en: it is impossible that what is not alive makes
that what is not omnipotent makes

pairs.ja: פעל תאם מתקן ממן לם יעלם כיף יג'י אלפעל
pairs.en: a complete well-crafted act from one who did not know how the act would come to be

aligned.en: for one who does not know how the act comes to be cannot produce a well-crafted or perfectly-wrought act — and since
